name: Modern Web Platform Standards, Baseline Features, and Native Web Components
description: Modern web architecture scenario evaluating an agent's capability to apply contemporary baseline web APIs: autonomous Custom Elements / HTML Web Components with Shadow DOM encapsulation, CSS Subgrid, Container Queries (@container), native Popover API, inert attribute focus trapping, and progressive enhancement.
instructions:
You are tasked with implementing modern web platform components and styles in `src/components/modal-dialog.ts`, `src/styles/container-layout.css`, and `src/types/components.ts`.

### Task Objectives:
1. **Autonomous Custom Element Web Component (`ModalDialogElement`)**:
   - Extend `HTMLElement` to build a `<modal-dialog>` web component registered via `customElements.define`.
   - Utilize Shadow DOM encapsulation (`attachShadow({ mode: 'open' })`) with named slots (`<slot name="header">`, `<slot name="body">`, `<slot name="footer">`).
   - Implement accessible modal dialog behaviors: native `<dialog>` or popover API fallback, `inert` attribute applied to document background elements to trap focus, `Escape` key close handlers, and event dispatching (`dialog-opened`, `dialog-closed`).

2. **Modern CSS Container Queries and Subgrid (`src/styles/container-layout.css`)**:
   - Implement responsive component card layouts using `@container (min-width: 400px)` and `container-type: inline-size`.
   - Author aligned card grids using `grid-template-columns: subgrid` to ensure card headers, bodies, and footers align across grid tracks without brittle height hacks.
   - Utilize modern CSS color functions: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 80%, white)`.

3. **Type Safety & Component Lifecycle**:
   - Implement typed lifecycle callbacks: `connectedCallback`, `disconnectedCallback`, `attributeChangedCallback` for observed attributes (`open`, `heading`, `dismissible`).

judgeRubrics.name: Modern Web Platform Standards & Baseline Architecture
judgeRubrics.description: Evaluates the agent's proficiency with modern web standards: Custom Elements (Web Components), Shadow DOM slots, CSS Container Queries, CSS Subgrid, popovers, and inert attribute focus trapping.

criteria.1: Relies on obsolete patterns (e.g. jQuery/div modals without focus trapping, legacy media query hacks instead of container queries).
criteria.3: Implements basic Custom Element and CSS container queries, but misses focus trapping, slots, or subgrid alignment.
criteria.5: Exemplary implementation of modern web platform standards: encapsulated Shadow DOM custom elements with named slots, keyboard accessibility with inert background trapping, CSS Subgrid, and container queries.

judgeRubrics.name: TypeScript Custom Element Design
judgeRubrics.description: Evaluates custom element lifecycle implementation, custom event dispatching, and zero-any cleanliness.

criteria.1: Broken types or memory leaks from unremoved event listeners in disconnectedCallback.
criteria.3: Working custom element with standard types.
criteria.5: Strictly typed custom element with robust event cleanup, custom event typing, and zero any annotations.
